kpiid-desc: Sign-in through KPI ID for accounts an administrator has linked to an EMPLOYEE_ID
kpiid-not-authorized: Your KPI ID account has no access to this wiki. Ask a wiki administrator to link it to your wiki account.
kpiid-loginreqpagetext:
Sign in with KPI ID to view the pages of this wiki.
$1
kpiidaccounts-summary: Accounts whose owners sign in through KPI ID, each linked to the owner's EMPLOYEE_ID. Create an account for a new person here, or link an existing account. Every change goes to [[Special:Log/kpiid|the KPI ID log]].
kpiidaccounts-username-help: The name the person appears under in the wiki. Sign-in goes through KPI ID by the EMPLOYEE_ID, whatever the name.
kpiidaccounts-existing-help: Link the account with this username instead of creating one. Its real name and email stay as they are.
kpiidaccounts-created: Created the account [[User:$1|$1]]. Its owner can sign in through KPI ID.
kpiidaccounts-linked: Linked the account [[User:$1|$1]]. Its owner can sign in through KPI ID.
kpiidaccounts-unlinked: Removed the EMPLOYEE_ID from [[User:$1|$1]]. Its owner can no longer sign in.
kpiidaccounts-list-empty: No account is linked to an EMPLOYEE_ID yet.
kpiidaccounts-error-employeeid-taken: EMPLOYEE_ID $1 already belongs to [[User:$2|$2]]. An EMPLOYEE_ID can belong to one account only.
kpiidaccounts-error-username-exists: The account [[User:$1|$1]] already exists. To link it, tick "{{int:kpiidaccounts-existing}}".
kpiidaccounts-error-email: "$1" is not a valid email address.
kpiidaccounts-error-linked: [[User:$1|$1]] is already linked to EMPLOYEE_ID $2. Remove that link first.
kpiidaccounts-error-own-account: You cannot remove the link of your own account: you would lose access to the wiki.
right-kpiid-manage: Create accounts for KPI ID sign-in and link them to EMPLOYEE_IDs
log-description-kpiid: Accounts created for KPI ID sign-in and changes of their EMPLOYEE_IDs.
